title: Oscar and the Portrait
author: Ulyana Eastwick
blurb: Noor Underhill, an urban explorer mapping tunnels that aren't on any survey, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. Then all the photographs from grandma's house now include an extra chair — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
